description: Christchurch City Council Open Data Portal is a data portal run by Christchurch City Council. The council portal lists open GIS and tabular data on roads, water supply, wastewater, stormwater, facilities and hazards such as flood management areas and liquefaction, as downloads and services. Coverage: Christchurch. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as shp, geojson, csv; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("no page title") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support urban infrastructure and hazard exposure studies of Christchurch. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
